Luminous cups were first mentioned in Records of the Ten Continents Within the Seas, where the Western Hu offered a "luminous ever-full cup" to King Mu of Zhou, crafted from the "essence of white jade," glowing at night and containing fine wine. The luminous cups seen today are mostly carved from Qilian dark jade.
